_note: wording: BA review — English drafted with AI
partialBanner: Partial results — the scan didn't fully complete (timeout or rate limit). Items found so far can still be downloaded.

queue.youtubeDisabled: YouTube downloads aren't available yet. Adding to the queue is temporarily disabled.
queue.cookieInvalid: Invalid cookie. Update the cookie to add items to the queue.

section.hasMore: There are more items — click "Expand" to load more.
section.expandHint: Click this section to expand it and pick individual items.

expired.title: Session expired
expired.body: The previous discovery results have expired.

cookieUnavailable.title: Cookie not configured
cookieUnavailable.body: {{platform}} needs a session cookie from that platform itself to view this content, but none is available. Signing in to VidGrab does not grant access to the source. Contact an admin to add one (Settings → Cookie).

cookieExpired.title: Cookie expired
cookieExpired.body: The {{platform}} cookie has expired. Please update it in Settings → Cookie → {{platform}}.

cookieBlocked.title: Cookie temporarily blocked
cookieBlocked.body: {{platform}} rate-limited us or detected a bot. The cookie unblocks automatically after 15 minutes (soft block) or 6 hours (hard block). Try again later.

cookiePartial.title: Partial content
cookiePartial.body: Public content is shown in full. Some posts need access from the source platform and may be skipped when adding to the queue.

singleDisabled.title: Single YouTube videos are temporarily unavailable
singleDisabled.body: We can't fetch single YouTube videos right now. You can try pasting a channel or playlist link to browse in bulk, if that is available. Please check back later.

proxyBad.title: YouTube is temporarily unavailable
proxyBad.body: We can't fetch content from YouTube right now. Please try again later. If this continues, contact an admin.

generic.cookieTitle: A cookie from the source platform is needed for this feature
generic.cookieBody: {{platform}} needs a session cookie from that platform itself. Signing in to VidGrab does not grant access to the source. Contact an admin to add one.
generic.proxyBody: We can't scan YouTube channels or playlists right now. Please try again later, or contact an admin if this continues.
